review_kind: Manual specification and literal-generator source review; no corpus semantic execution

coherent_boundaries: Consumed legal prefix bytes include pending bytes; completed scalar output commits before a later same-chunk error.
Offending byte examined but not consumed; original pending/error evidence persists, future chunks are ignored without work.
Pending EOF has no offending byte, new consumption or examination; successful finalization ends the stream.
Strict valid UTF8 includes rawNUL/ASCIIcontrols/DEL/BOM/noncharacters; surrogate scalar encodings, overlong encodings and out-of-range values are excluded.
ASCII JSONescape/unclosed JSONprefix controls prove only UTF8 decoding; no JSON or grammar membership.
